+//go:build !integration
+
+package session
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"crypto/x509/pkix"
+	"io"
+	"math/big"
+	"net"
+	"net/http"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"net/url"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"software.sslmate.com/src/go-pkcs12"
+
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/iostreams"
+	"gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/testing/cmdtest"
+)
+
+func TestServeTrustsTheJVMTrustStoreMavenAndGradleWouldLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	registryCert, registryCA := selfSignedServer(t)
+	registry := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
+		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "ok")
+	}))
+	registry.TLS = &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, Certificates: []tls.Certificate{registryCert}}
+	registry.StartTLS()
+	t.Cleanup(registry.Close)
+	_, otherCA := selfSignedServer(t)
+
+	dir := t.TempDir()
+	store := writeTrustStore(t, filepath.Join(dir, "registry.p12"), "s3cret", registryCA)
+	other := writeTrustStore(t, filepath.Join(dir, "other.p12"), "s3cret", otherCA)
+	jks := filepath.Join(dir, "store.jks")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(jks, []byte{0xfe, 0xed, 0xfe, 0xed, 0, 0, 0, 2}, 0o600))
+	javaHome := filepath.Join(dir, "jdk")
+	writeTrustStore(t, filepath.Join(javaHome, "lib", "security", "cacerts"), "changeit", registryCA)
+	opts := func(path string) string {
+		return "-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=" + path + " -Djavax.net.ssl.trustStorePassword=s3cret"
+	}
+
+	cases := []struct {
+		name    string
+		env     map[string]string
+		wantOK  bool
+		wantLog string
+	}{
+		{name: "MAVEN_OPTS", env: map[string]string{"MAVEN_OPTS": opts(store)}, wantOK: true},
+		{name: "GRADLE_OPTS", env: map[string]string{"GRADLE_OPTS": opts(store)}, wantOK: true},
+		{name: "Maven and Gradle name different stores", env: map[string]string{"MAVEN_OPTS": opts(other), "GRADLE_OPTS": opts(store)}, wantOK: true},
+		{name: "the JDK default cacerts", env: map[string]string{"JAVA_HOME": javaHome}, wantOK: true},
+		{name: "no JVM truststore"},
+		{name: "a store glab cannot read", env: map[string]string{"MAVEN_OPTS": opts(jks)}, wantLog: "warning: registry connections do not trust JVM truststore"},
+	}
+	for _, c := range cases {
+		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			for _, v := range []string{
+				"GITLAB_CI", "HTTPS_PROXY", "https_proxy", "HTTP_PROXY", "http_proxy", "NO_PROXY", "no_proxy",
+				"JAVA_HOME", "MAVEN_OPTS", "MAVEN_DEBUG_OPTS", "MAVEN_ARGS", "MAVEN_BASEDIR",
+				"JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", "JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS", "_JAVA_OPTIONS", "GRADLE_OPTS", "JAVA_OPTS",
+			} {
+				t.Setenv(v, "")
+			}
+			t.Setenv("GLAB_DF_FAKE_DEFAULT", "allow")
+			for k, v := range c.env {
+				t.Setenv(k, v)
+			}
+
+			p := startServe(t)
+			resp, err := p.client.Get(registry.URL + "/ping")
+			if err == nil {
+				_ = resp.Body.Close()
+			}
+			log := p.stop()
+
+			if c.wantOK {
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.StatusCode)
+			} else {
+				require.Error(t, err, "an untrusted registry must not be fetched")
+				assert.Contains(t, log, "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority")
+			}
+			if c.wantLog != "" {
+				assert.Contains(t, log, c.wantLog)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+type servedProxy struct {
+	client *http.Client
+	stop   func() string
+}
+
+type lockedBuffer struct {
+	mu  sync.Mutex
+	buf bytes.Buffer
+}
+
+func (b *lockedBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
+	b.mu.Lock()
+	defer b.mu.Unlock()
+	return b.buf.Write(p)
+}
+
+func (b *lockedBuffer) String() string {
+	b.mu.Lock()
+	defer b.mu.Unlock()
+	return b.buf.String()
+}
+
+func startServe(t *testing.T) servedProxy {
+	t.Helper()
+	stateDir := t.TempDir()
+	stderr := &lockedBuffer{}
+	ios, _, _, _ := cmdtest.TestIOStreams(iostreams.WithStderr(stderr, false))
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
+	t.Cleanup(cancel)
+	done := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		done <- Serve(ctx, ServeConfig{ProjectID: "group/proj", BaseDir: t.TempDir(), StateDir: stateDir, IO: ios})
+	}()
+
+	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
+	var addr []byte
+	for len(addr) == 0 {
+		addr, _ = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(stateDir, AddrFile))
+		select {
+		case err := <-done:
+			t.Fatalf("Serve returned before it was ready: %v\n%s", err, stderr.String())
+		case <-time.After(20 * time.Millisecond):
+		}
+		require.True(t, time.Now().Before(deadline), "Serve did not become ready")
+	}
+	proxyURL, err := url.Parse("http://" + strings.TrimSpace(string(addr)))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	transport := &http.Transport{
+		Proxy:           http.ProxyURL(proxyURL),
+		TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, InsecureSkipVerify: true}, //nolint:gosec // client -> inspection proxy hop only; glab verifies the registry
+	}
+
+	return servedProxy{
+		client: &http.Client{Transport: transport, Timeout: 10 * time.Second},
+		stop: func() string {
+			transport.CloseIdleConnections()
+			cancel()
+			require.NoError(t, <-done)
+			return stderr.String()
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+func selfSignedServer(t *testing.T) (tls.Certificate, *x509.Certificate) {
+	t.Helper()
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	serial, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, new(big.Int).Lsh(big.NewInt(1), 128))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	tmpl := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          serial,
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "test registry"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		IPAddresses:           []net.IP{net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1)},
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, tmpl, tmpl, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return tls.Certificate{Certificate: [][]byte{der}, PrivateKey: key, Leaf: cert}, cert
+}
+
+func writeTrustStore(t *testing.T, path, password string, certs ...*x509.Certificate) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	der, err := pkcs12.Modern.EncodeTrustStore(certs, password)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700))
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, der, 0o600))
+	return path
+}

+func Test_MRForCurrentBranch_UpstreamFallback(t *testing.T) {
+	const (
+		localBranch    = "local-name"
+		upstreamBranch = "upstream-name"
+		trackedConfig  = "branch.local-name.remote origin\nbranch.local-name.merge refs/heads/"
+	)
+	upstreamMR := &gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{IID: 7, SourceBranch: upstreamBranch, WebURL: "https://gitlab.com/foo/bar/-/merge_requests/7"}
+	localMR := &gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{IID: 3, SourceBranch: localBranch, WebURL: "https://gitlab.com/foo/bar/-/merge_requests/3"}
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		args []string
+		// gitConfig is the stubbed `git config` output for the local branch.
+		// Leave it empty for a branch without tracking configuration.
+		gitConfig string
+		// strict resolves without WithUpstreamBranchFallback.
+		strict        bool
+		mrs           map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest
+		listErr       error
+		projectErr    error
+		wantLookups   []string
+		wantGitCalls  int
+		wantProjectFn bool
+		wantIID       int64
+		wantNotice    string
+		wantErr       string
+	}{
+		{
+			name:          "renamed local branch resolves through its upstream",
+			gitConfig:     trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			mrs:           map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{upstreamBranch: upstreamMR},
+			wantLookups:   []string{localBranch, upstreamBranch},
+			wantGitCalls:  1,
+			wantProjectFn: true,
+			wantIID:       7,
+			wantNotice:    "No merge request found for branch \"local-name\". Using !7 from its upstream branch \"upstream-name\".\n",
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "lookup without the fallback option stays strict",
+			strict:      true,
+			gitConfig:   trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			mrs:         map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{upstreamBranch: upstreamMR},
+			wantLookups: []string{localBranch},
+			wantErr:     `no open merge request available for "local-name"`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "local branch name wins without consulting the upstream",
+			gitConfig:   trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			mrs:         map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{localBranch: localMR, upstreamBranch: upstreamMR},
+			wantLookups: []string{localBranch},
+			wantIID:     3,
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "explicit branch argument is taken literally",
+			args:        []string{localBranch},
+			gitConfig:   trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			mrs:         map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{upstreamBranch: upstreamMR},
+			wantLookups: []string{localBranch},
+			wantErr:     `no open merge request available for "local-name"`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:         "branch without an upstream",
+			mrs:          map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{upstreamBranch: upstreamMR},
+			wantLookups:  []string{localBranch},
+			wantGitCalls: 1,
+			wantErr:      `no open merge request available for "local-name"`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:         "upstream with the same name",
+			gitConfig:    trackedConfig + localBranch,
+			wantLookups:  []string{localBranch},
+			wantGitCalls: 1,
+			wantErr:      `no open merge request available for "local-name"`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:          "upstream is the default branch",
+			gitConfig:     trackedConfig + "main",
+			mrs:           map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{"main": {IID: 9, SourceBranch: "main"}},
+			wantLookups:   []string{localBranch},
+			wantGitCalls:  1,
+			wantProjectFn: true,
+			wantErr:       `no open merge request available for "local-name"`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:          "upstream has no merge request either",
+			gitConfig:     trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			wantLookups:   []string{localBranch, upstreamBranch},
+			wantGitCalls:  1,
+			wantProjectFn: true,
+			wantErr:       `no open merge request available for "local-name" or its upstream branch "upstream-name"`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:        "API failure on the local lookup is not retried",
+			gitConfig:   trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			listErr:     errors.New("API call failed"),
+			wantLookups: []string{localBranch},
+			wantErr:     `failed to get open merge request for "local-name": API call failed`,
+		},
+		{
+			name:          "default branch lookup failure is reported",
+			gitConfig:     trackedConfig + upstreamBranch,
+			mrs:           map[string]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{upstreamBranch: upstreamMR},
+			projectErr:    errors.New("API call failed"),
+			wantLookups:   []string{localBranch},
+			wantGitCalls:  1,
+			wantProjectFn: true,
+			wantErr:       `failed to get the default branch of foo/bar: API call failed`,
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ios, _, _, stderr := cmdtest.TestIOStreams()
+			f := cmdtest.NewTestFactory(ios,
+				cmdtest.WithBaseRepo("foo", "bar", ""),
+				cmdtest.WithBranch(localBranch),
+			)
+			var lookupOpts []MRLookupOption
+			if !tt.strict {
+				lookupOpts = append(lookupOpts, WithUpstreamBranchFallback())
+			}
+
+			cs, teardown := test.InitCmdStubber()
+			t.Cleanup(teardown)
+			if tt.gitConfig == "" {
+				cs.StubError("")
+			} else {
+				cs.Stub(tt.gitConfig)
+			}
+
+			origListMRs, origGetProject, origGetMR := api.ListMRs, api.GetProject, api.GetMR
+			t.Cleanup(func() { api.ListMRs, api.GetProject, api.GetMR = origListMRs, origGetProject, origGetMR })
+
+			var lookups []string
+			api.ListMRs = func(_ *gitlab.Client, _ any, opts *gitlab.ListProjectMergeRequestsOptions, _ ...api.CliListMROption) ([]*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest, error) {
+				lookups = append(lookups, *opts.SourceBranch)
+				if tt.listErr != nil {
+					return nil, tt.listErr
+				}
+				if mr, ok := tt.mrs[*opts.SourceBranch]; ok {
+					return []*gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{mr}, nil
+				}
+				return nil, nil
+			}
+			projectFetched := false
+			api.GetProject = func(_ *gitlab.Client, projectID any) (*gitlab.Project, error) {
+				projectFetched = true
+				assert.Equal(t, "foo/bar", projectID)
+				if tt.projectErr != nil {
+					return nil, tt.projectErr
+				}
+				return &gitlab.Project{DefaultBranch: "main"}, nil
+			}
+			api.GetMR = func(_ *gitlab.Client, _ any, mrID int64, _ *gitlab.GetMergeRequestsOptions) (*gitlab.MergeRequest, error) {
+				return &gitlab.MergeRequest{BasicMergeRequest: gitlab.BasicMergeRequest{IID: mrID}}, nil
+			}
+
+			gotMR, _, err := MRFromArgs(t.Context(), f, tt.args, "any", lookupOpts...)
+
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantLookups, lookups)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantNotice, stderr.String())
+			assert.Len(t, cs.Calls, tt.wantGitCalls)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantProjectFn, projectFetched)
+			if tt.wantErr != "" {
+				assert.EqualError(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+				return
+			}
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantIID, gotMR.IID)
+
+			// The same resolution backs `glab mr view --web`.
+			cs.Stub(tt.gitConfig)
+			gotURL, _, err := MRWebURLFromArgs(t.Context(), f, tt.args, "any", lookupOpts...)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.mrs[tt.wantLookups[len(tt.wantLookups)-1]].WebURL, gotURL)
+		})
+	}
+}
